description: Unit test class for ImmutableDittoLogger, testing its immutability, logging behavior, MDC handling, and thread safety.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggerTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for ImmutableDittoLogger, verifying its behavior, thread safety, immutability, and MDC handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MDC observer before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Deregisters MDC observer after each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableDittoLogger instances are immutable, skipped due to mutability checker limitations.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that passing null to create an ImmutableDittoLogger throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the logger name is correctly returned.

methods.name: withSameCorrelationIdReturnsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks that calling withCorrelationId with the same ID returns the same logger instance.

methods.name: logInfoWithCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests logging an info message with a correlation ID, verifying MDC entries and logger calls.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcAndDoNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no MDC modifications or logs occur if info is disabled.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcButLogInfo
methods.description: Tests that if correlation ID is null, MDC remains unchanged but message is logged.

methods.name: putCorrelationIdToMdcAndLogDebugInfoWarnAndError
methods.description: Verifies MDC entries are set and logs are called across different levels.

methods.name: twoThreadsTwoLoggers
methods.description: Tests thread safety and correct MDC handling across multiple threads.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntries
methods.description: Tests adding multiple MDC entries and logging behavior.

methods.name: removeCorrelationIdViaNullValue
methods.description: Tests removing MDC entries by setting correlation ID to null.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Tests removing a specific MDC entry via its key.
